text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Arima Kinen on the horizon,
Rice Shower
is asked to take part in a
joint interview.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-huh?! I'm going to be in the middle?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
You won the popularity poll! Of course a
star like
you would be in the middle!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but... but today—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Rice. Please make your responses quick
and crisp.
There is another interview
after the photoshoot
as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's right. It wouldn't do to start
without
the star.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I believe you also plan to announce
you will
"run the ultimate race," correct?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My! Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I look forward to seeing such a
sight.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, no... Everyone looks so scary...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Aughhh... Not you too, Big Brother...
choice_data_list_en: Being the lead is tough, huh.
Being the lead is tough, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Aughhh... Not you too, Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, the interview concludes. As a
reward
and to blow off some steam, Rice
Shower and I
head out into town.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Phew... I was so nervous.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thanks... I can't believe they put me in
the center
between those two.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If you had told me three years ago that
would
happen, I would have assumed
you were telling
me about a dream.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I can hardly believe it myself. It's
like a
magical holiday miracle...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, no, I think you're the one who
performed
this miracle.
choice_data_list: サンタがくれたのかも
choice_data_list_en: Maybe Santa gave it to you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, no, I think you're the one who
performed
this miracle.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even though I've messed up so much,
you've
always stayed with me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You're the reason I've come this far. I
couldn't
have made such miraculous
progress... without
you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hey, what kind of present do you want?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hey, what kind of present do you want?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You're always giving me gifts, so...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to return the favor, even if it's just

something small.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...That's it? You don't want anything
else?
choice_data_list: 君が頑張ってる姿を見たいかな
貴方が頑張ってる姿を見たいかな
choice_data_list_en: I think I just want to see you giving it your all.
I think I'd rather see you give it your all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. I'll work as hard as I can.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll make you smile, but not just for the
holidays!
I'll keep you happy forever and
ever!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll make you smile, but not just for the
holidays!
I'll keep you happy forever and
ever!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you my best running and make
you super
happy!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Great!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...No way! That's not enough!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I was going to work hard even if you
didn't ask me
to! So...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna work harder than hard to get
you the
best present of all... First place
at the Arima
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That's a present that only I can give you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome! Now you've got another
reason
to look forward to this year's
Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What was supposed to be a chance to
take a
break has become a very
invigorating holiday.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you for today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Thank you for today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Once the Arima Kinen is here, I'm going
to make
you happy, along with everyone
else!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Once the Arima Kinen is here, I'm going
to make
you happy, along with everyone
else!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having declared that, Rice Shower runs
off with a
skip in her step.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's so much more resolute now than
she was
when we first met. It looks like
this time I'm the
one who'll have to catch
up to her.
